blocks.text: RETURNING asks PostgreSQL to show values from a row it has just changed. It is useful for reading an automatically made id.
Use PostgreSQL in a new practice database through psql or a database editor. These are PostgreSQL examples, not SQLite. They do not run in this site's SQL playground. Use only sample data.

blocks.title: Return an inserted value

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `RETURNING` reads values from rows changed by the statement, including an automatically generated id.

blocks.text: The inserted row is shown with its generated id and Moon Trip title.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not guess the next id in a real app. Use the value the database returns.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Insert another sample book and inspect its id.
